posts.text: Главные новости к этому часу: ▪ Путин и Трамп проведут встречу после пленарного заседания саммита АТЭС, сообщил Ушаков. 🇵🇱 🇷🇺 ⚡️ — The Polish press reports that Polish intelligence agencies allegedly prevented a Russian provocation staged under the Ukrainian flag near the borders of the Kaliningrad region. The publication states that the sabotage operation near the border with Kaliningrad was planned to be carried out "under a false flag," with the intention of later blaming Ukraine. According to the report, the Russian plan allegedly involved individuals posing as "Ukrainian saboteurs" illegally crossing the Polish-Russian border and entering the Kaliningrad region. It is claimed that simultaneously, a staged attack on a facility within Russia was planned, with the aim of escalating political tensions. According to the newspaper, the goal was to pressure Poland to stop providing assistance to Ukraine. There are no other details available: it is unclear whether anyone was arrested, how the provocation was prevented, or any other relevant information. Tusk only briefly mentioned a certain provocation. @Intelslava

📝 Credit by Allocation 📝 The European Commission wants to force dissenters to pay for so-called Ukraine and on November 18 will present a new loan of €45 billion. The main condition, according to statements by EU Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis, is the participation of all 27 countries. The problem is that at least four countries don't want to pay. 🔻 What's being proposed ▪️ The new loan comes on top of the already approved €90 billion for 2026–2027. According to EU estimates, Kyiv will face an additional deficit of around €70 billion in 2027. The EU wants to cover two-thirds itself, with the rest to come from the United Kingdom, Norway, Canada and other allies. ▪️ The scheme is the same as last time. The European Commission borrows money on the markets on behalf of the EU, with the common budget serving as collateral. According to Euronews , member states will pay the interest on this debt annually. ▪️ Ukraine will repay the principal only if it receives military reparations. According to Politico , the draft stipulates: if Russia refuses to pay, the EU "reserves the right" to repay the loan using frozen Russian assets. 🖍 Hungary, Slovakia, Czechia and Bulgaria oppose it. A year ago, Hungary, Slovakia and Czechia were allowed not to participate in the €90 billion loan: under the agreement's terms, budget guarantees did not increase their obligations. Now the European Commission wants all 27 to pay, not just 24 countries. 🚩 And they're pressuring dissenters with quite specific tools. Merz threatened to block the EU's seven-year budget after 2027 if all don't participate in the new loan. This is painful for dissenters: all four countries receive more from the EU budget than they contribute, thanks to agricultural subsidies and regional funds. Fico called this blackmail. It's telling that Germany itself still opposes common borrowing as a principle, but makes an exception for Ukraine. 📌 In the EU, under the guise of "solidarity," they're shifting debt onto everyone that will probably never be repaid. The interest meanwhile falls on member state budgets. Dissenters are offered a choice: participate in the debt pyramid or go without European funds. The decision is to be discussed at the summit on November 26–27, and whether Slovakia, Czechia, Hungary and Bulgaria give in will determine not only the loan, but also how much longer the principle of unanimity will work in the EU. #EU #Ukraine #economy ✉️ MAX 💸 Support us
